advisories.summary: Proposer settings loaded from --proposer-settings-file or --proposer-settings-url reject unknown keys. Gloas is scheduled on Sepolia at epoch 353024, but this build still defaults Sepolia proposers to a 60M gas limit.
advisories.action: Remove unknown keys from the proposer settings file before upgrading. Sepolia operators must upgrade, with an execution client that has Amsterdam, before Oct 6, 2026, 13:53:36 UTC. To propose at 200M gas, set gas_limit to 200000000 in the v2 proposer settings. --suggested-gas-limit does not apply after Gloas.

advisories.summary: --with-builder, --enable-builder, and --suggested-gas-limit only produce pre-Gloas mev-boost registrations.
advisories.action: Do not rely on those three flags for Gloas builder settings. Use version 2 proposer settings.
